title: Norm of a homogenized affine form
statement: Let $n\ge0$, $a_0\in\mathbb R$, and $a\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb R$. The uniform $L^1$ norm on $\{−1,1\}^{n+1}$ of the linear form with coefficients $(a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n)$ equals the uniform $L^1$ norm on $\{−1,1\}^n$ of the affine form $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$.
